projects.title: Toyota Fortuner, ivory diamond
projects.summary: Three rows of ivory Nappa-grade PU with a matching suede roof liner and cream mats.
projects.brief: A family of six wanted the dark factory interior to feel lighter for long drives to Ooty, and easy to wipe after the kids.
projects.did: Ivory diamond PU on all three rows, a cream suede roof liner and matching 7D mats, with brown thread to hide wear.
projects.quote: Six months and two road trips later, the ivory still looks new. Juice spills wipe straight off.
alts: Ivory diamond-quilted seats in a Toyota Fortuner
Second-row ivory captain view of the Fortuner cabin
Ivory seats and cream mats seen from the rear row

projects.title: Kia Seltos, graphite honeycomb
projects.summary: Graphite perforated honeycomb covers with a matching hand-stitched steering wrap.
projects.brief: Arjun drives two hours a day and wanted seats that stay cool and look factory-fitted, not like add-on covers.
projects.did: Graphite honeycomb perforated covers on all five seats with tonal black thread, plus a graphite steering wrap stitched in the car.
projects.quote: They had a pattern for my 2023 Seltos already. The covers look factory-fitted and nothing shifts.
alts: Graphite honeycomb seats in a Kia Seltos
Front seats and steering wrap in the Seltos
Rear bench in graphite honeycomb

projects.title: Innova Hycross, mocha captain
projects.summary: Mocha Nappa-grade PU on captain seats and the third row, with a mocha steering wrap.
projects.brief: A taxi-turned-family car that needed to look premium for weekend trips while surviving daily school runs.
projects.did: Mocha diamond-quilt covers on captain seats and third row, armrests wrapped to match, and a mocha steering wrap with amber thread.
projects.quote: The captain seats feel like business class now. Our drivers keep complimenting the stitching.
alts: Mocha leather captain seats in an MPV
Mocha second-row captain seats
Third row in mocha leather

projects.title: Mahindra Thar, tan channel
projects.summary: Tan channel-pleated covers, a tan steering wrap and 7D mats for an open-top Thar.
projects.brief: An open-roof weekend car that sees sun, dust and the odd rain shower. The owner wanted warm tan without babying it.
projects.did: Tan channel-pleat PU with UV-stable finish, a tan wrap with black thread and 7D mats with raised edges for dust.
projects.quote: Roof off half the year and the tan still looks rich. Dust just wipes away.
alts: Tan leather seats in an off-roader
Tan front seats and dashboard
Tan rear seats

projects.title: Honda Amaze, navy fabric
projects.summary: Navy jacquard fabric covers with 3D tray mats for a cool, practical daily sedan.
projects.brief: A teacher's daily car with no shade at work. She wanted something cool, smart and easy to keep clean.
projects.did: Navy jacquard covers with tonal stitching and waterproof 3D tray mats for the monsoon.
projects.quote: No more burning seats at 3 pm. It looks so much smarter than the beige it came with.
alts: Navy fabric seats in a sedan
Navy front seats
Navy rear bench

projects.title: MG Hector, oxblood leather
projects.summary: Oxblood Nappa-grade PU with a matching wrap and amber ambient lighting.
projects.brief: The owner wanted a bold, warm cabin that felt like a European grand tourer at night.
projects.did: Oxblood diamond covers with black piping, a matching steering wrap and 64-colour ambient lighting set to amber.
projects.quote: Friends ask which variant came with red leather. None did. That is the best compliment.
alts: Oxblood red leather seats in an SUV
Red leather front seats
Red leather rear seats

projects.title: Maruti Swift, red sport
projects.summary: Black perforated sport covers with a red insert and red contrast stitching.
projects.brief: A first car, bought second-hand, that needed to feel sporty and new without spending on new seats.
projects.did: Sport perforated covers with a racing-red centre insert, red stitching and a matching gear boot.
projects.quote: The red stripe looks like it came from a GT variant. Best money I spent on the car.
alts: Red sport seats in a hatchback
Red and black front sport seats

projects.title: Tata Altroz, grey perforated
projects.summary: Ash grey perforated covers with a grey steering wrap, light and airy for a hatchback.
projects.brief: A young couple wanted a lighter, more open feel than the factory black, without it getting dirty fast.
projects.did: Ash grey perforated covers with white thread and a grey steering wrap.
projects.quote: Grey with white thread makes the small cabin feel bigger. Fitting was done before lunch.
